landmarks.gorbeau-house: The narrow tiled-roof building between the two garden properties, above its street end.
landmarks.gorbeau-house-entrance: The gap and short approach at the lower edge of the Gorbeau property.
landmarks.gorbeau-adjoining-boulevard: The open road directly before the house.
landmarks.gorbeau-police-ambush: Among the three trees opposite, beside the partly bare elm.
landmarks.barriere-gobelins-wall: The street side of the separate wall east of the downward branch.
landmarks.rue-petit-banquier-corner: The rounded corner at the upper edge of the boulevard.
landmarks.rue-petit-banquier-low-wall: The street-facing low boundary of the waste-ground enclosure west of Petit-Banquier.
landmarks.paris-boulevard-hopital: An unobstructed point on the broad boulevard, beyond the lettering.

landmarks.rue-chanvrerie: The main funnel-shaped road west of the wine-shop.
landmarks.chanvrerie-barricade: The road near the western side of the wine-shop enclosure; the barrier itself is not painted.
landmarks.chanvrerie-barricade-opening: The northern street edge at the end of the planned barrier.
landmarks.chanvrerie-barricade-cut: The narrow approach immediately within that northern end.
landmarks.chanvrerie-barricade-exterior: The exposed road west of the barrier position.
landmarks.chanvrerie-barricade-torch: The enclosed street beside the western part of the wine-shop frontage.
landmarks.rue-chanvrerie-artillery-position: The Saint-Denis end of the street, facing the barrier position.
landmarks.mondetour-small-barricade: The lower Mondétour branch beside the wine-shop block; the barrier itself is not painted.
landmarks.mondetour-open-approach: The upper Mondétour passage toward Rue des Prêcheurs.
landmarks.mondetour-lane-outside: The lower passage beyond the smaller barrier position.
landmarks.chanvrerie-tall-house: The high house row closing the street immediately east of the junction.
landmarks.corinthe: The wine-shop roof footprint below-left of the junction.
landmarks.corinthe-door: The frontage threshold on the upper edge of the wine-shop footprint.
landmarks.corinthe-exterior: The road immediately outside the wine-shop frontage.
landmarks.corinthe-sheltered-angle: The recess screened from the western approach by the wine-shop corner.
landmarks.chanvrerie-sewer-grating: The ground near the inner base of the small barrier; the hidden grating is not painted.
